scope: Independent H15 backend source review by frontend owner; no source edits, Cargo/Git fixture execution, browser, App, Agent, installation or user-data access in this review.
result: No remaining blocking backend finding in the sealed source scope after the corrections below. Not whole-product, installed-app, Windows or H15 completion.

reviewedBoundaries.finding: Prepare generates and actually verifies a separate recovery package, never deletes. Generic start rejects remove. Dedicated confirm requires exact live maintained prepared operation plus archive revision/recovery id/bundle and manifest hashes; dispatch intent is saved before Git. Duplicate confirmation does not repeat execution.

Enumerates HEAD, ORIG_HEAD, FETCH_HEAD, refs/worktree and both old/new reflog OIDs including orphaned private-ref logs. Known files are hashed into evidence; unrecognized private layouts are rejected instead of silently omitted. All admitted roots and their complete reachable objects are exported without adding source refs or fetching remotes.

Bundle is imported into an independent second repository, exact roots/object closure checked, HEAD materialized under the captured safe checkout profile, then physical bytes/links/Git executable mode compared. Actual owner tests include source objects made unavailable and private orphan roots. Dirty index or physical dirty/untracked/ignored/extra empty-directory material that cannot be reproduced blocks deletion.

Original/retained parents and source identities are rechecked. Reserved backup leaf stamp now flows into build; replacement or nonempty leaf is rejected. Git creates bundle in temporary staging, independently restores it, then bounded create_new/NOFOLLOW publication refuses existing destination files and symlinks. Final parent/leaf checks retain original identities.

Maintenance admission, metadata seal and worker ownership remain until actual worker/process completion; cancellation is intent, not rollback. Root verification checks cancel before each next Git read. Known refusals retain exact action/id. Release failures remain storageUnknown; cold false maintenance is not proof of an old process ending.

Cold records do not restart or confirm work; current removed receipt is withdrawn while durable intent/recovery remains. Persisted per-archive dispatched marker prevents acknowledgement or replacement current intent from regranting disposal. Read-only reconciliation checks exact absence/identities/Git registration and preserved branch.

Exact canonical new parent/name, absent destination, current recovery proof and explicit action required. Recovery creates an independent existing-owned repository with all protected recovery refs; it gains no created-linked deletion authority and never applies a draft or changes old conversation cwd.

limitsAndRemaining: I/O still uses paths for directory creation/Git commands; identity checks detect stable external replacement but are not an OS-wide lock or fully handle-relative mutation. A race can leave material and unknown result; there is no automatic rollback or deletion of uncertain material.

Recovery is admitted Git commit/object and checkout-content recovery, not preservation of arbitrary ACLs, xattrs or all unsupported private Git state. Current limits include 4096 roots, 50000 objects and 256MiB packed/object budget; over-limit/unsupported sources remain explicit refusals.
No remote freshness or pushed status is inferred from local tracking information; no remote query/fetch is performed.

Successful deletion removes the archive entry while keeping recovery records and old conversation cwd. At review time archive-only historical notice lacked a recovery-specific entry after removal; root assigned verification a separate red/fix/followup. This review does not mark NEW-07 or all H15 complete.
Full seven checks, candidate source closure and installed delete/recover interaction remain root followup; no formal App or real Agent acceptance is supplied by this review.
